needs: draft from a spellbook (Alchemy, digital-only): the player picks one of three random cards of a named card's spellbook and puts it into hand, the given number of times.
detain (CR 701.35): until the controller's next turn the permanent can't attack or block and its activated abilities can't be activated.
an effect that ends a creature's suspected designation (CR 701.60d).
an effect that ends a permanent's prepared state, the other half of become_prepared.
an effect that ends the goaded state a creature has, whoever goaded it.
an attacking creature that becomes blocked with nothing blocking it (CR 509.1h).
a permanent turned face down by an effect, a 2/2 with no text and no name (CR 708.2).
a card put onto the battlefield face down that is neither manifested nor cloaked: FaceDown has only those two values, and a third has no way to be turned up.
an Aura put onto the battlefield enchanting a player: Entering.attach_player exists for a spell, nothing sets it for a card put there by an effect.
a color in EntersAs, for a card that enters as a black Zombie or similar in addition to what it is.
a target slot whose most is a number read as the targets are chosen, such as one plus the cards in graveyards: TargetSpec holds a constant, or the announced X.
a card already in exile that gains suspend, with the time counters it was given (CR 702.62): the triggers read CardDef.suspend, which a card without it does not have.
the ante zone (CR 407, casual only): a card moved there stays out of play until the ante is settled.
a card moved to the command zone by an effect (CR 408), for commanders and their replacement.

a divided total on an activated ability, on a mode of a modal spell or ability, or on a slot past the first: only a spell's and a triggered ability's first slot divide.
